text:
Ellie: Hey team — quick heads-up: next Friday is my last day. I'm switching to full-time parenthood! 🍼✨ I'm planning a tiny farewell + baby shower in the kitchen on Thursday 3–4pm. Would love to see folks. If you can bring something, reply with what you can bring (snacks/drinks/plant/gift). No pressure! Thanks for everything — it's been such a joy to work with you all.

Sam: Congrats!!! 🎉 I'll bring coffee and croissants.

Ravi: Sad we'll lose you as an SME but so happy for you. I'll handle folding chairs/cleanup.

Maya: Plant idea +1. Could we do a small lilac or rosemary? Low light-friendly.

Amanda: I can do homemade empanadas (2 dozen). Also a card.

Ellie: Love the lilac idea — apartment-friendly. Amanda you're a saint, thank you.

DevOps Bot: Calendar invite created for Thu 3:00–4:00pm. Capacity note: kitchen occupancy 15 people. RSVP with a reaction or reply here.

Sam: Adding :thumbsup: to the invite. PS ellie don't forget to take my succulent.

Maya: Can someone pick up a small watering can? I can grab one if no one else volunteers.

Ravi: I'll grab it tomorrow.

Ellie: Thank you all so much. Means a lot. Also here's a tiny wish list if anyone asked: newborn sleepers size 0–3m, white muslin swaddles, or a little coffee shop gift card :relaxed: 

Amanda: Noted!

Sam: One last thing — team photo?

Ellie: Yes please! 3:45pm photo ops. See you there ❤️
